cues: The calcium carbide used to ripen mangoes does not release ethylene.
It releases acetylene, along with toxic impurities, so the fruit looks ripe but tastes of nothing.
Carbide ripening is prohibited in Nepal.
text: A warning from the market. The calcium carbide used to ripen mangoes does not release ethylene. It releases acetylene, along with toxic impurities, so the fruit looks ripe but tastes of nothing. Carbide ripening is prohibited in Nepal.
